tools.name: search_hotels
tools.description:
Search the chain's hotels (worldwide, several thousand) by location, stars, brand, status and amenities, with pagination.

    All filters are optional and combined with AND. Always pass `country` (ISO code, e.g. "FR") together with `city`
    when the country is known or implied: a search on "Paris

tools.name: get_hotel_details
tools.description:
Return the complete details of one hotel (descriptions, address, location, contacts, policies, page URL, amenity IDs).

    Requires a valid hotel_id: call search_hotels first if you only know the hotel name or city.

    No availability, rates or booking: for those, give the user the page_url or th

tools.name: get_amenities
tools.description:
Return the amenities of one hotel, or the chain's global amenity catalogue when hotel_id is omitted.

    Call it without hotel_id to discover the valid amenity IDs to use in search_hotels.

    No availability, rates or booking: this tool only returns descriptive information.

tools.name: get_hotel_photos
tools.description:
Return the photo gallery of a hotel (URLs and captions), optionally limited to the cover photo.

    No availability, rates or booking: this tool only returns descriptive information.
